links.comparator_used: Baseline physician messages with GDRs not shown (clinician-authored replies without AI drafts)
links.outcome: Draft usage, alignment with final physician messages, readability, and provider-reported time savings and cognitive load
links.effect: Of 66,200 GDRs generated, 21,073 were presented and 2,264 (11%) were used; used GDRs aligned with final messages (BLEU 0.49, ROUGE-L 0.60, BERTScore F1 > 0.9); final messages were longer and more readable; providers reported time savings and reduced cognitive load
links.tradeoff: Low uptake (11% of presented drafts used) and declining usage over time; drafts were less readable than final physician messages; workflow integration needs improvement
links.quote: GDR usage declined over time, yet providers reported time savings and reduced cognitive load.

links.comparator_used: Initial Phase 1 prompt compared with refined prompts in Phases 2-4
links.outcome: Token retention of GDR text in final messages
links.effect: Prompt refinements increased token retention (no numeric effect reported in the abstract)

design_hint: prompt refinement and clinician review/editing of AI draft replies
